rationale: Test Ridge versus nontrivial baselines to falsify possible overclaim from depth-only comparator
previous_result_known: Ridge beats depth-only baseline across 8 non-independent posthoc holdouts

fixed_comparators.method: mean by depth from train floats
mean by pressure + austral calendar month, fallback depth-only
mean by pressure + 10-degree latitude band, fallback depth-only
mean five nearest training floats at same pressure by haversine great-circle distance, no tuning

ridge_spec: same 9 features, training-only normalization, fixed alpha=10
success_gate: No automatic model promotion; report all comparator losses and wins by split and target; no attempt to optimize on result
blocked_conclusions: not transport or ice-shelf melt estimation
retention: append-only result JSON with source SHA and GitHub CI link
